queries.text:
SecurityLabEvents
| summarize
    TotalEvents = count(),
    FirstEvent = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastEvent = max(TimeGenerated)

SecurityLabEvents
| where EventSource == "WindowsSecurity"
| where EventID == "4625"
| summarize
    FailedLogons = count(),
    FirstFailure = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastFailure = max(TimeGenerated)
    by Computer, TargetDomainName, TargetUserName, SourceIp,
       WindowStart = bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where FailedLogons >= 5
| order by FailedLogons desc
| project Computer, TargetUserName, SourceIp, FailedLogons, WindowStart

let Failures = SecurityLabEvents
| where EventSource == "WindowsSecurity" and EventID == "4625"
| project Computer, TargetDomainName, TargetUserName, SourceIp, LogonType,
          FailureTime = TimeGenerated;
let Successes = SecurityLabEvents
| where EventSource == "WindowsSecurity" and EventID == "4624"
| project Computer, TargetDomainName, TargetUserName, SourceIp, LogonType,
          SuccessTime = TimeGenerated, SuccessEventId = LabEventId;
Successes
| join kind=inner (Failures)
    on Computer, TargetDomainName, TargetUserName, SourceIp, LogonType
| where FailureTime >= SuccessTime - 10m
    and FailureTime < SuccessTime
| summarize
    FailedLogons = count(),
    FirstFailure = min(FailureTime),
    LastFailure = max(FailureTime)
    by Computer, TargetDomainName, TargetUserName, SourceIp, LogonType,
       SuccessTime, SuccessEventId
| where FailedLogons >= 5
| project Computer, TargetUserName, SourceIp, LogonType,
          FailedLogons, FirstFailure, LastFailure, SuccessTime
| order by SuccessTime asc
| project Computer, TargetUserName, SourceIp, LogonType, FailedLogons, SuccessTime

SecurityLabEvents
| where EventSource == "WindowsSecurity"
| where EventID == "4720"
| where TargetDomainName =~ Computer
| project TimeGenerated, Computer,
          CreatedBy = SubjectUserName,
          NewAccount = TargetUserName,
          TargetDomainName
| order by TimeGenerated asc
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, CreatedBy, NewAccount

SecurityLabEvents
| where EventSource == "Sysmon" and EventID == "1"
| where Image endswith @"\powershell.exe"
| where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(^|\s)-(encodedcommand|enc)\s"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, User, ParentImage, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated asc

SecurityLabEvents
| where EventSource == "Sysmon" and EventID == "1"
| summarize
    Executions = count(),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by Computer, Image
| where Executions == 1
| order by FirstSeen asc
| project Computer, Image, Executions, FirstSeen

SecurityLabEvents
| where EventSource == "Sysmon" and EventID == "3"
| where Initiated == true
| where ipv4_is_private(DestinationIp) == false
| summarize
    Connections = count(),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by DestinationIp, DestinationPort, Protocol
| where Connections <= 3
| order by Connections asc, FirstSeen asc
